run_make_submission_file: run the CLI script to create an evalAI submission file from OC20 or OC22 split results
run_make_submission_file_is2re_relaxatio: run the CLI script with --is2re-relaxations to write IS2RE results from trajectory directories
run_make_submission_file_hybrid: run the CLI script with --is2re-relaxations and --hybrid to write IS2RE results from S2EF NPZ files
run_write_predictions: run write_predictions to merge split result files into a single compressed NPZ submission file
run_write_is2re_relaxations: run write_is2re_relaxations to extract energies from ASE trajectory files for IS2RE submission
